criteria.name: section_coverage
criteria.reason: Covers Abstract and sections 1–7 with no missing first-level sections.

criteria.name: concision
criteria.reason: Each section is summarized in 1–3 sentences, generally tight and to the point.

criteria.name: faithfulness
criteria.reason: Methods, components, and claimed results align plausibly with the paper; a few dataset/metric specifics feel slightly speculative.

criteria.name: writing_quality
criteria.reason: Clear, coherent, and grammatically sound with good technical phrasing.

overall_reason: Strong, concise coverage across all sections with mostly faithful detail and good readability; minor uncertainty on a few specifics.
